stem: Which statement about minimally invasive management of caries in children is accurate?

options.text: Interim therapeutic restorations can provide caries control in a child with multiple open lesions before definitive restoration.
38% SDF is limited to arresting lesions in permanent teeth.
Sealants and Hall-technique crowns are excluded from the minimal intervention options for ECC.
Every caries lesion must be restored in order to stop the disease process.
